<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Spinning Stand](/Feats.aspx?ID=5443) <actions string="Single Action or Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 68

**Archetype** [Clawdancer](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=221)

**Prerequisites**
[Clawdancer Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5436)

**Requirements**
You’re [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88).

</column>

---

You flare your legs around, using the momentum to both lash out and return to a standing position. You enter talon stance if you weren't in it already, make a spinning talon Strike against an enemy in reach, and then [Stand](/Actions.aspx?ID=2303). You don't take the -2 circumstance penalty for attacking while prone, and your Stand action doesn't trigger reactions. You can spend two actions using Spinning Stand to make two spinning talon Strikes instead of one; these Strikes must be against separate targets.
name: Spinning Stand
